name: 児童発達支援事業者に犯罪事実確認を義務化
summary: 現行条例の第47条を改め、指定児童発達支援事業者に、障害児と接する対象業務の従事者について犯罪事実確認などを求めます。児童対象性暴力等を防ぎ、発生した場合に障害児を保護するための規定で、2026年12月25日に施行します。
changes: 対象業務の従事者について犯罪事実確認などを事業者に義務付ける
who: 指定児童発達支援事業者
障害児と接する対象業務の従事者
why: 基準の一部改正に伴い、対象業務に従事する人の犯罪事実確認などを定めるためと、県は説明しています。

issues.quote: 対象業務の従事者について犯罪事実確認などを事業者に義務付ける
issues.note: 原文には第59条への第47条の追加と、第78条等の引用範囲の変更もある。犯罪事実確認等の規定の適用先に関わる変更が抜けていないか確認が必要。

en.name: Requires child development support providers to conduct criminal background checks
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Standards for Staffing, Equipment and Operation of Designated Outpatient Support Services, etc.
en.summary: The amendment changes Article 47 of the current ordinance. It requires designated child development support providers to conduct criminal record checks and other checks on workers in covered duties who come into contact with children with disabilities. The provisions aim to prevent sexual violence against children and similar acts, and to protect children with disabilities if such an incident occurs. They take effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Requires providers to conduct criminal record checks and other checks on workers in covered duties
who: Children with disabilities and their guardians
Workers in covered duties who come into contact with children with disabilities
en.why: The prefecture says the ordinance sets out requirements for criminal record checks and other checks of people engaged in covered duties, following a partial revision of the standards.
